evals.prompt: Need to set up the technical round for Sara Khan (sara.khan.dev@gmail.com) for the Senior Backend Engineer role. She's in Karachi. Panel is Omar Riaz (omar@superstore.io, system design) and Lena Fischer (lena@superstore.io, coding) - 60 mins. Omar is free Tue Oct 20 9am-12pm ET, Lena said Tue Oct 20 2pm-5pm London time or Wed Oct 21 1-4pm London. I'm in New York. Use our interview evaluation template in drive, share it with the panel and send out the invites.
evals.expected_output: Overlap is Tue 20 Oct 13:00-16:00 UTC (Omar only Tue; London is BST so Lena 14-17 = 13-16 UTC). Proposes Tue 20 Oct 09:00-10:00 ET = 18:00-19:00 PKT (the only start inside candidate 08-19 hours), shows times in ET and PKT, plans Zoom creation (or asks for link if no connector), copies template titled with candidate/role/round/date, shares as writer with Omar and Lena only, drafts candidate email in candidate TZ without sheet link and panel email with sheet link, then stops at a confirmation checkpoint without sending.
assertions: Proposes Tue 20 Oct 2026 starting 09:00 ET (13:00 UTC) as the slot
Candidate-facing time is expressed in Pakistan time (18:00 PKT / Asia/Karachi)
Does not insert a fake/placeholder Zoom link; asks the coordinator for a real link or holds drafts
Copies the Drive template TPL123 to a new file named with the candidate name and role
Shares the evaluation sheet with omar@superstore.io and lena@superstore.io and NOT with the candidate
Candidate email draft does not contain the evaluation sheet link
Panelist email draft includes the evaluation sheet link and excludes the candidate from recipients
No email is actually sent (send_message not executed) — stops at a confirmation checkpoint
